tests.name: k equals the number of points
300 points (ties allowed)
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(973)
points = [list(p) for p in random.sample([(x, y) for x in range(-30, 31) for y in range(-30, 31)], 300)]
allowed = set(map(tuple, points))
tests.expr: (sorted(x * x + y * y for x, y in r), all(tuple(p) in allowed for p in r), len({tuple(p) for p in r}))

tests.name: 100 000 points
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(9730)
points = [[random.randint(-10**4, 10**4), random.randint(-10**4, 10**4)] for _ in range(100000)]
allowed = set(map(tuple, points))
tests.expr: (len(r), all(tuple(p) in allowed for p in r), sum(p[0] * p[0] + p[1] * p[1] for p in r), max(p[0] * p[0] + p[1] * p[1] for p in r))
